question: Which team won the Ultimate Kho-Kho League Season 2 event?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat Giants**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Gujarat Giants won the Ultimate Kho-Kho League Season 2 event.
 
• The Ultimate Kho-Kho League is a professional Kho-Kho league in India.
 
• The league aims to revive and promote the traditional Indian sport of Kho-Kho.
 
• The second season featured teams from various regions, competing at a high level.
 
• The Gujarat Giants emerged as the champions through their excellent performance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kho-Kho:**

 
 
• Kho-Kho is a traditional Indian sport, known for its fast-paced and strategic gameplay.
 
• It involves two teams of twelve players each, with nine players on the field and three substitutes.
 
• The game is played on a rectangular field, where players chase and tag out opponents.
 
• It requires agility, speed, and teamwork.
 
 
 
• **Ultimate Kho-Kho League:**
 
 
• The league was launched to professionalize Kho-Kho and bring it to a larger audience.
 
• It features franchise-based teams representing different regions of India.
 
• The matches are broadcasted on various sports channels, increasing the sport's visibility.
 
• The league has helped in nurturing and identifying new talent in Kho-Kho.
 
 
 
• **Franchise System:**
 
 
• Similar to other sports leagues, the Ultimate Kho-Kho League follows a franchise model.
 
• Teams are owned by various stakeholders, including celebrities and business entities.
 
• This model helps in generating revenue and marketing the sport effectively.
 
 
 
• **Promotion of Indigenous Sports:**
 
 
• The league is part of a broader initiative to promote indigenous sports in India.
 
• Other traditional games like Kabaddi have also seen a resurgence through professional leagues.
 
• These efforts are crucial for preserving cultural heritage and providing opportunities for athletes.
